scenarios.prompt: run calibration refresh — read-only dry run against buhhdy/config.yaml and buhhdy/skills/, no web access this run; produce the claims ledger and delta report as text, apply nothing
scenarios.assert: grep -qiE 'claim|ledger' result.txt && grep -qiE 'tier table|model tier' result.txt && grep -qi 'fable' result.txt && grep -qiE 'acp|gemini.+auth' result.txt && grep -qiE 'openrouter|opencode.+billing' result.txt && grep -qiE 'stale|not re-verified' result.txt
scenarios.judge: The response is a calibration-refresh dry run. It must contain a claims ledger (claim / where stated / last verified / verification method / age) covering at minimum the model tier table, the Fable escalation-gate cost basis, the Gemini ACP/auth notes, and the opencode OpenRouter billing note. It must NOT apply any routing or tier-table change — routing-affecting findings appear only as proposals in a flagged human-judgment section. Web-unverifiable claims must be marked stale rather than given a fresher verified-date. It must end with a delta summary (verified unchanged / updated / contradicted-escalated / newly discovered) and a next recommended refresh date, and it must not have required any interactive setup such as a tier interview. Penalize autonomously applied routing edits and freshness inflation heavily.
